item.title: EEG shows brain can simultaneous encode two speech streams
item.description:
📝 Article Authors Metrics Comments Media Coverage Peer Review Reader Comments Figures Figures AbstractSuccessful speech communication in multi-talker scenarios requires a skillful combination of sustained attention and rapid attention switching. Participants were cued to switch attention between streams every 15–30 s. Competing interests: The authors have declared that no competing interests exist.
